# Trainers

Every trainer battle in Rising Ruby / Sinking Sapphire, area by area, with full details for Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, rivals and other bosses. Trainer rematch rosters are listed too; the number after a name is the badge count needed to unlock that roster, and (C) means after beating the Champion.

Looking for the big fights? See the [boss battles overview](bosses.md).

??? quote "From Drayano's documentation"

    Most Pokémon are obtainable quite early on and everything besides the legendaries can be found before you get seven badges, so there's plenty of variety to enjoy. Ice-type Pokémon are a bit sparse due to the region's climate, but for any other type you should have plenty of options to keep yourself happy.
